spans.s:
mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Burnt, scorched, consumed by fire.
f. (-ग्धा)
1 The quarter where the sun is observable.
2 An epithet of certain lunations, on which it is unlucky to do any thing, and religious rites are prohibited.
n. (-ग्धं)
A fragrant grass.
E.
दह to burn, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
A raven, or perhaps the carrion crow.
E.
दग्ध burnt, (black,) and काक crow.

mfn. (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be burnt.
E.
दह to burn, तव्य aff.

f. (-का)
Scorched rice.
E.
दग्ध burnt, कन् depreciative affix, and the fem. form.

f. (-का)
A burnt or vitrified brick.
E.
दग्ध burnt, and इष्टक a brick.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Hungry, starving.
n. (-रं)
The appetite, an empty or craving stomach.
E.
दग्ध, and उदर the belly.

ind.
Having burnt.
E.
दह to burn, क्त्वा aff.
